verdict.rationale: Issuing offers declarative spending controls that automatically block by merchant category, country, merchant ID or card presence, and enforce per-authorization or monthly limits. A synchronous webhook lets your code approve or decline each authorization in real time, and agent-scoped virtual cards are invalidated automatically after use. Beyond those fixed control types, though, any event-driven logic means writing and hosting your own webhook handler; the evidence shows no general rule or workflow builder. Missing for 10: a configurable event-to-action rule engine beyond spending controls, documented triggers for events other than authorizations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
